seo_title: MELA AERI 1500 LED Arch Mirror | Bathroom Mirror | ETS
seo_desc: MELA AERI 1500 x 900 LED arch mirror: dimmable warm, natural or cool white light, touch control, IP54. Pickup or local delivery in Perth.

input.title: MELA AERI 1500 LED Arch Mirror
input.descriptionHtml:
The MELA AERI 1500 LED arch mirror is a wide landscape mirror with a soft arched top, a backlit LED halo and a touch dimmer. At 1500 mm wide it suits a double vanity or a long single vanity where you want one mirror instead of two.

  • Size: 1500 mm wide × 900 mm high (AERI.1500LED.1)
  • Shape: Landscape arch with a slim frame
  • Light: Backlit LED around the edge of the mirror for even, shadow-free light at the vanity
  • Light colour: Warm white, natural white or cool white (3000–6000 K), dimmable, CRI over 80
  • Control: Touch button on the mirror face for on/off, colour and brightness, with memory so it comes back on at your last setting
  • Power: 220–240 V, plug-in or hard-wired; hard-wiring must be done by a licensed electrician
  • Rating: IP54 splash and dust protection
  • Mounting: Wall-mounted, easy to install
  • Warranty: 3 years on the mirror (MELA)
  • Care: Clean with 30% methylated spirits in water on a soft cloth. No Windex-type glass cleaners, bleach, ammonia or abrasives, and keep water off the back and edges

Pairs well with the 1500 and 1800 mm double vanities. Browse more LED bathroom mirrors.

Delivery

  • Too long for Australia Post: pickup from Maddington or Perth metro delivery. Ask us for a freight quote elsewhere.

seo.title: MELA AERI 1500 LED Arch Mirror | Bathroom Mirror | ETS
seo.description: MELA AERI 1500 x 900 LED arch mirror: dimmable warm, natural or cool white light, touch control, IP54. Pickup or local delivery in Perth.

metafields.value: Copper-free silver mirror, slim frame, backlit LED

Clean with a 30% methylated spirits / 70% water mix on a soft cloth. Keep water off the back and edges and wipe around the edge to stop salt and calcium build-up. Do not use Windex or similar glass cleaners, bleach, ammonia, acidic cleaners, alcohol or mineral-based solvents, or abrasive pads.
